mapper.select: SELECT id, template_name, template_type, template_content, template_variables, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_prompt_template WHERE template_type = #{templateType} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, template_name, template_type, template_content, template_variables, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_prompt_template WHERE template_name = #{templateName} AND status = 1
SELECT id, template_name, template_type, template_content, template_variables, description, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_system_prompt_template WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_system_prompt_template (template_name, template_type, template_content, template_variables, description, status) VALUES (#{templateName}, #{templateType}, #{templateContent}, #{templateVariables}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_system_prompt_template SET template_name = #{templateName}, template_type = #{templateType}, template_content = #{templateContent}, template_variables = #{templateVariables}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
